scope: Mechanical clang-format and analyzer repairs across existing main sources.

findings: The deterministic gate failures were real main debt, not toolchain drift: clang-format violations reproduced identically under LLVM 20, 21, and 23, and clang-tidy/cppcheck findings reproduced on clean origin/main.
ui-preview failures varied across at least 11 assertions. Fixed pump windows raced dialog focus, sidebar shortcut arming, strip reveal, config watcher debounce, and frame presentation.

terminal-input failures varied among paste, command-chord, and suggestion-presentation deadlines. Native activation/exposure, terminal focus, clipboard readiness, and frame-driven seen state were not established immediately before input.
